Save weather plots

Source: R/SaveWeatherPlots.R
SaveWeatherPlots.Rd

Creates selected weather plots and saves them to a specified directory.

Usage

SaveWeatherPlots(
  data,
  plots = c("temperature", "air_temperature", "temperature_difference", "rainfall",
    "soil_temperature", "wind_speed", "relative_humidity", "leaf_wetness",
    "solar_radiation"),
  monthly_grids = TRUE,
  path = getwd(),
  width = 8,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300,
  device = "png"
)

Arguments

data

A data frame containing weather data in long format. The data must contain the columns `Date`, `DOY`, `variable`, and `value`.

plots

Character vector specifying the plots to create. Available options are `"temperature"`, `"air_temperature"`, `"temperature_difference"`, `"rainfall"`, `"soil_temperature"`, `"wind_speed"`, `"relative_humidity"`, `"leaf_wetness"`, and `"solar_rad"`.

path

Character string giving the directory in which to save the plots. The directory will be created if it does not exist.

width

Width of each saved plot in inches. Default is 8.

height

Height of each saved plot in inches. Default is 5.

dpi

Resolution of saved images in dots per inch. Default is 300.

device

Character string specifying the output image format. Default is `"png"`.

Value

Invisibly returns a character vector containing the paths of the files created.

Author

Gareth Burns

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
SaveWeatherPlots(
  weather,
  plots = c(
    "temperature",
    "rainfall",
    "soil_temperature"
  ),
  path = "plots"
)
} # }
